results.title: Logistic terrorist base eliminated in Tillabéry region, Niger - African Initiative - news agency
results.snippet:
The Niger National Guard has killed two militants and destroyed a logistics base belonging to armed terrorist groups on the outskirts of Kobagué, in the Torodi district of the Tillabéry region. The Guard announced this in a press release on 17 November.

The operation, carried out on 16–17 November, was conducted by a National Guard squadron in Torodi in conjunction with the Alpha Zero unit. [...]
